content_zh:
学校体育馆，盛辉和宁小凡拿着器材室的钥匙，来取器材。
“今天是最后一节体育课了，凡哥，待会儿打球不？”
盛辉学着艾弗森单手运球，动作蠢萌蠢萌的。
“行，好久没打了，等下打爆你！”
宁小凡自信一笑，当年他打球的时候，这货还在玩乒乓球呢。
“呵呵，你就吹吧。”盛辉翻着白眼道。
两人互相调侃，来到地下一层，咔嚓一声呜呜呜呜……
一股诡异的阴风刮过。
两人齐打了个冷颤，器材室黑黢黢一片，温度比外面低了一大截。
“凡哥，这里太恐怖了，我们拿了球赶紧走吧……”盛辉一副怯手怯脚的样子。
宁小凡也觉得这里面不太对劲，夏日炎炎的，就算是地下室也没这么冷吧？冻得他鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。
“凡哥，你有没有听说过……器材室以前出过人命，一个女老师被铅球砸死了……后来灯就一直修不好，他们都说是闹鬼……”
盛辉冷不丁来了句。
宁小凡刚准备骂他，余光中，倏然亮起了一道绿色幽光！
他刚要上前查看，忽然门外闯进来一队人马，手里拎着钢管、甩棍等家伙，把他们层层围了起来。
盛辉一看这阵仗，差点没吓尿。
“你……你们是谁？想干……干什么？！”
宁小凡眉头一皱，将盛辉护在了身后。
“宁小凡！”
随着一声愤怒的长吼，顾天宇拨开人群走来，周围的混混个个狞恶嚣张，就差在脸上写个狂字，不知道还以为在拍《古惑仔之校园风云》呢。

“哟，顾班长，你这是玩的哪出？”宁小凡强行镇定下来，淡淡笑道。
“你特么少给本少装蒜！”
顾天宇用棍子戳了戳宁小凡胸口，瞪着他道：“前几天的事情，你以为就这么算了？”
“前几天？”
宁小凡眨了眨眼，旋即恍然大悟。
“哦！我想起来了……你是说过要直播吃垃圾来着。咋滴，今天叫这么多人，一起围观啊？”
“宁小凡，你找死！”一瞬间，顾天宇脸色变得极为难看。
这时，八个混混中走出一个精壮的花臂青年，眼神阴翳，双臂纹满刺青。
“凡哥，别来无恙啊。”
宁小凡瞥了一眼，他认识这个混混，本名不详，绰号壁虎。
一年前，他给天水街老大赵坤戴了顶绿帽子，被二十个混混追砍了七条街，最后还是宁小凡出手救了他。后来他拜宁小凡为大哥，发誓同甘共苦，结果三个月就叛变了。
这也让宁小凡看清了这些所谓的“兄弟”
“既然认识你凡哥，还不快滚！”宁小凡冷喝道。
“哟呵？”
壁虎似乎来了兴致，他朝地上狠啐一口，阴笑道：
“煞笔玩意，叫你一声凡哥是给你面子，你还真把自己当颗蒜了！你也不上街打听打听，如今谁还认识你，你还以为你是当年那个宁疯子？”
“两年前你怎么不敢这么说？”宁小凡嘲讽地冷笑。
“壁虎哥，他几个意思啊？”壁虎旁边一个小弟疑惑地问道。
“关你什么事，给老子闭嘴！”
壁虎被戳到痛处，抬手就给那小弟一记耳光，后者捂着懵逼的脸，满腹委屈。

壁虎扭头看向宁小凡，咬牙切齿道：
“宁小凡，今时不同往日，当年你宁疯子的确很厉害！但现在，清江一中八条街我壁虎说了算！”
说着，他还嚣张地用大拇指指了指自己，然后朝地上狠狠吐了口浓痰，凶横道：
“宁疯子？你现在就是一堆垃圾！”
“我不做大哥好多年，我不爱冰冷的窗沿……”骂完，壁虎还捏着嗓子，阴阳怪气儿地唱起了《大哥》。
“去你妈的！”
先下手为强，宁小凡一个飞踹，壁虎还没唱两句就被踹飞出去，砸在地上门牙都崩掉半截。
“给我上，弄死他！”壁虎嘴里满是血，说话还漏风，但疯狂怒吼着。
顿时，器材室里，一场混战拉开帷幕。
盛辉只是个普通学生，哪是这些社会混混的对手，几下就被揍得鼻血飚溅。
“你们给我住手！！”
忽然，一道气急败坏的娇喝声响了起来，是楚惜颜。
她见两人拿器材半天不回来，就过来看看，哪想目睹了这一幕。
可这群混混已经上了头，哪会听她的话，继续和宁小凡厮杀在一起。顾天宇在一旁不断吆“弄死他！弄死他！”
“顾天宇，你个混蛋！快让他们住手啊！”楚惜颜小脸气得通红，对着顾天宇怒喝。

content_en:
In the school gymnasium, Sheng Hui and Ning Xiaofan came to get the equipment with the keys to the equipment room.
"Today is the last physical education class. Brother Fan, will you play ball later?"
Sheng Hui imitated Iverson in dribbling with one hand, making cute and cute moves.
"Okay, I haven't fought for a long time. I'll beat you up later!"
Ning Xiaofan smiled confidently. When he was playing basketball, this guy was still playing table tennis.
"Haha, just brag." Sheng Hui rolled his eyes and said.
The two of them teased each other, and when they came to the underground floor, they clicked woo woo woo...
A strange dark wind blew.
Both of them shivered. The equipment room was dark and the temperature was much lower than outside.
"Brother Fan, this place is too scary. Let's get the ball and leave quickly..." Sheng Hui looked timid.
Ning Xiaofan also felt that something was wrong here. It was hot in the summer, so even the basement wasn't that cold, right? It was so cold that he got goosebumps.
"Brother Fan, have you ever heard that... there was a fatality in the equipment room before? A female teacher was killed by a shot put... Then the lights could not be repaired. They all said it was haunted..."
Sheng Hui said something unexpectedly.
Ning Xiaofan was just about to scold him when a green light suddenly lit up in his peripheral vision!
Just as he was about to step forward to check, a group of people suddenly burst in from outside the door, carrying steel pipes, swing sticks and other things in their hands, and surrounded them layer by layer.
Sheng Hui almost peeed when he saw the battle.
"You...who are you? What do you want...to do?!"
Ning Xiaofan frowned and protected Sheng Hui behind him.
"Ning Xiaofan!"
With an angry roar, Gu Tianyu walked through the crowd. The gangsters around him were all vicious and arrogant. They almost had the word "Crazy" written on their faces. I don't know, they thought they were filming "Young and Dangerous: Campus Storm".
"Hey, Squad Leader Gu, where are you kidding?" Ning Xiaofan forced himself to calm down and smiled lightly.
"Don't you dare to pretend to be stupid!"
Gu Tianyu poked Ning Xiaofan in the chest with a stick, glared at him and said, "What happened a few days ago, do you think this is the end of it?"
"A few days ago?"
Ning Xiaofan blinked and suddenly understood.
"Oh! I remembered... you said you were going to live broadcast eating garbage. Why, did you invite so many people to watch together today?"
"Ning Xiaofan, you are seeking death!" In an instant, Gu Tianyu's face turned extremely ugly.
At this time, a strong young man with colorful arms walked out from among the eight gangsters. He had dark eyes and his arms were covered with tattoos.
"Brother Fan, you're fine."
Ning Xiaofan glanced at him. He knew this gangster. His real name was unknown and he was nicknamed Gecko.
A year ago, he cuckolded Zhao Kun, the boss of Tianshui Street, and was chased through seven streets by twenty gangsters. In the end, Ning Xiaofan rescued him. Later, he worshiped Ning Xiaofan as his eldest brother and vowed to share the joys and sorrows with him. However, he rebelled within three months.
This also allowed Ning Xiaofan to see clearly these so-called "brothers"
"Since I know you, Brother Fan, why don't you get out of here!" Ning Xiaofan shouted coldly.
"Yo ho?"
The gecko seemed to be interested. He spat on the ground and said with a sinister smile:
"What a shame, calling you Brother Fan is just to give you face, but you really treat yourself like a fool! You don't go out on the street to ask around. Who still knows you now? Do you still think you are the crazy Ning from back then?"
"Why didn't you dare say that two years ago?" Ning Xiaofan sneered mockingly.
"Brother Gecko, what does he mean?" A boy next to Gecko asked doubtfully.
"It's none of your business, shut up!"
When the gecko was poked in a painful spot, he raised his hand and slapped the younger brother in the face. The latter covered his confused face and was full of grievances.
Gecko turned to look at Ning Xiaofan, gritted his teeth and said:
"Ning Xiaofan, today is different from the past. Back then, you, Madman Ning, were really powerful! But now, I, Gecko, have the final say on the eight streets of Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School!"
As he spoke, he arrogantly pointed at himself with his thumb, then spit out thick phlegm on the ground and said fiercely:"Crazy Ning? You are just a piece of garbage now!"
"I haven't been a big brother for many years. I don't like the cold window sill..." After scolding, Gecko still pinched his throat and sang "Big Brother" in a sinister manner.
"Fuck you!"
To strike first, Ning Xiaofan gave the gecko a flying kick. Before he could even sing a few words, he was kicked out and hit the ground, half of his front teeth shattered.
"Fuck him, kill him!" The gecko's mouth was full of blood, and his words were leaky, but he roared crazily.
Suddenly, a melee broke out in the equipment room.
Sheng Hui was just an ordinary student. He was no match for these social gangsters. He was beaten until his nose bled in a few blows.
"Stop it!!"
Suddenly, an angry shout rang out, it was Chu Xiyan.
When she saw that the two men had not come back after taking their equipment for a long time, she came over to take a look. She never expected to witness this scene.
But these gangsters were already in trouble, so they would not listen to her and continue to fight with Ning Xiaofan. Gu Tianyu kept shouting from the side, "Kill him! Kill him!"
"Gu Tianyu, you bastard! Tell them to stop!" Chu Xiyan's face turned red with anger and she shouted angrily at Gu Tianyu.
